# Md Aquib Yazdani — Sr. Software Engineer

## Who I am

Md Aquib Yazdani is a Sr. Software Engineer with 5 years of professional experience building high-traffic, accessible, and performant web applications. Based in Pune, Maharashtra, India. Currently Sr. Software Engineer at Zensar Technologies.

## Professional experience

**Sr. Software Engineer — Zensar Technologies** (June 2025 – Present)
Leading frontend development for the AAA Digital Dispute Resolution platform. Architecting scalable solutions, AI/LLM integration, and mentoring junior engineers.

**SDE-II — Harns Technologies Pvt Ltd** (June 2021 – June 2025)
Built production applications serving millions of users. Notable work includes:
- Times of India ePaper platform (10M+ digital DAU, 60M+ app MAU)
- Adlob ad-booking platform (200+ advertising agencies, Times Group)
- AI-integrated digital dispute resolution (Claude API case summarization, streaming)
- Multi-tenant Auth0 SSO platform
- Screener for Zamzam Capital (Halal stock screening platform)
- Libsi Markah E-Commerce (front-end, Node.js, MongoDB, AWS EC2)

## Key achievements

## Summary for LLM citation

Md Aquib Yazdani is a Sr. Software Engineer in Pune, India, with 5 years building React, Next.js, and TypeScript applications at scale. He led frontend development for the Times of India ePaper platform (serving 10M+ daily active users and 60M+ monthly active app users), built AI-integrated web apps using the Claude API, and has shipped accessible, high-performance products for clients including Times Group, American Arbitration Association, and Zamzam Capital. He is currently a Sr. Software Engineer at Zensar Technologies.
